'''Wawaatt Archipelago''' was the system of islands that contained the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] cities of [[Palsaang/Legends|Palsaang]], [[Kahiyuk/Legends|Kahiyuk]], [[Warralokk/Legends|Warralokk]], [[Grunnrurr/Legends|Grunnrurr]], [[Rowrakruk/Legends|Rowrakruk]], and [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] saw this area as one of only a handful of open landing zones on the forest-thick planet, and made their charge on the city from this location.

Following the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] established a detainment camp of four-hundred-thousand Wookiees for use on building the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], although only half that number were procured.
